summary: This feature allows pre-defining fixed amounts for specific 'Other Income' heads. When an entry is made for that mapped head, the amount automatically populates, reducing manual data entry and ensuring consistency.
steps: Create a mapper for an 'Other Income' head (e.g., 'Job Application Charges').
Assign a fixed amount to this mapped head (e.g., 200 rupees).
When making an 'Other Income' entry, selecting the mapped head will automatically populate the predefined amount.
business_rules: Used for 'Other Income' heads that have repeated, fixed amounts, such as standard application fees or minor service charges.
Automates the amount entry process, reducing errors and saving time.
For other income heads without a mapper, the amount must still be entered manually.
important_notes: This feature is particularly useful for recurring other income items with consistent pricing.
It streamlines the data entry process for finance personnel.
questions: How can I pre-define amounts for recurring other income entries?
